sjcos-browser-dns.service:
[Unit]
Description=SJC OS restricted browser resolver
ConditionPathExists=/etc/sjcos-browser/phase1-accepted
Requires=sjcos-browser-setup.service
After=sjcos-browser-setup.service
BindsTo=sjcos-browser-setup.service
[Service]
SupplementaryGroups=sjcos-browser
User=sjcos-browser-dns
Group=sjcos-browser-dns
Slice=user-@JOE_UID@-sjcosbrowser.slice
NetworkNamespacePath=/run/netns/sjcos-browser-gate
ExecStart=/opt/sjcos-browser/unbound/sbin/unbound -d -c /etc/sjcos-browser/unbound.conf
MemoryMax=64M
MemorySwapMax=0
CPUQuota=10%
TasksMax=8
Restart=no
Nice=15
UMask=0077
LimitCORE=0
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes

RuntimeDirectory=sjcos-browser-dns
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700
ReadWritePaths=/run/sjcos-browser-dns
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
sjcos-browser-gate.service:
[Unit]
Description=SJC OS bounded public read gate
After=sjcos-browser-dns.service
Requires=sjcos-browser-dns.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/sjcos-browser/phase1-accepted
Requires=sjcos-browser-setup.service
After=sjcos-browser-setup.service
BindsTo=sjcos-browser-setup.service
[Service]
SupplementaryGroups=sjcos-browser
User=sjcos-browser-gate
Group=sjcos-browser-controller
Slice=user-@JOE_UID@-sjcosbrowser.slice
NetworkNamespacePath=/run/netns/sjcos-browser-gate
ExecStart=/opt/sjcos-browser/py/bin/python -I -B /opt/sjcos-browser/node/source/deploy/browser/phase1-gate-entry.py
MemoryMax=384M
MemorySwapMax=0
CPUQuota=35%
TasksMax=32
ExecStopPost=+/usr/bin/python3 -I -B /opt/sjcos-browser/node/source/deploy/browser/browser-latch.py record
Restart=no
Nice=15
OOMPolicy=stop
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=15
UMask=0077
LimitCORE=0
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
LoadCredential=ca-key:/etc/sjcos-browser/credentials/gate-ca-key
LoadCredential=dispatch-public:/etc/sjcos-browser/credentials/read-dispatch-public

RuntimeDirectory=sjcos-browser-gate
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0750
ReadWritePaths=/run/sjcos-browser-supervisor /var/lib/sjcos-browser-supervisor /run/sjcos-browser-gate
InaccessiblePaths=/etc/sjcos-browser/credentials
ProtectProc=invisible
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
sjcos-browser-helper.service:
[Unit]
Description=SJC OS fixed nonroot Chromium process tree helper
Requires=sjcos-browser-setup.service sjcos-browser-supervisor.service
After=sjcos-browser-setup.service sjcos-browser-supervisor.service
BindsTo=sjcos-browser.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/sjcos-browser/phase1-accepted
[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
Group=sjcos-browser-controller
Slice=user-@JOE_UID@-sjcosbrowser.slice
NetworkNamespacePath=/run/netns/sjcos-browser
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -I -B /opt/sjcos-browser/node/source/deploy/browser/phase1-chromium-helper.py
ExecStopPost=+/usr/bin/python3 -I -B /opt/sjcos-browser/node/source/deploy/browser/browser-latch.py record
Restart=no
OOMPolicy=stop
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=15
Nice=15
UMask=0077
LimitCORE=0
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
RuntimeDirectory=sjcos-browser-helper sjcos-browser-chromium
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0750
ReadWritePaths=/run/sjcos-browser-supervisor /var/lib/sjcos-browser-supervisor /run/sjcos-browser-helper /run/sjcos-browser-chromium
TemporaryFileSystem=/run/sjcos-browser-chromium:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=384M,mode=0750
TemporaryFileSystem=/dev/shm:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=128M
InaccessiblePaths=-/run/credentials/sjcos-browser.service /etc/sjcos-browser/credentials
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_SETUID CAP_SETGID CAP_CHOWN CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE CAP_NET_ADMIN
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_NETLINK
sjcos-browser-proxy.service:
# REVIEW SPEC ONLY. A pinned dispatcher/parser shim is a release prerequisite.
[Unit]
Description=SJC OS request-aware browser gate
Requires=sjcos-browser-supervisor.service
After=sjcos-browser-supervisor.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/sjcos-browser/runtime-attested.json
ConditionPathExists=/etc/sjcos-browser/activation-approved

[Service]
Type=simple
User=sjcos-browser-gate
Group=sjcos-browser-gate
Slice=user-@JOE_UID@-sjcosbrowser.slice
NetworkNamespacePath=/run/netns/sjcos-browser-gate
ExecStartPre=+/usr/local/libexec/sjcos-browser-latch check
ExecStartPre=/usr/local/libexec/sjcos-browser-attest gate
# Not stock mitmdump: mandatory fail-closed dispatcher and preallocation ledger.
ExecStart=/opt/sjcos-browser/bin/sjc-mitmdump --options /etc/sjcos-browser/gate-options.conf
ExecStopPost=+/usr/local/libexec/sjcos-browser-latch record
Restart=no
MemoryMax=384M
MemorySwapMax=0
CPUQuota=35%
TasksMax=32
Nice=15
OOMPolicy=stop
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=15
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
PrivateDevices=true
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
LimitCORE=0
RuntimeDirectory=sjcos-browser-gate
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700
ReadWritePaths=/run/sjcos-browser-gate
LoadCredential=gate-ca:/etc/sjcos-browser/credentials/gate-ca
LoadCredential=gate-rpc:/etc/sjcos-browser/credentials/gate-rpc
# Content-free event RPC only: no default pretty-printer, trace or error body.
StandardOutput=null
StandardError=null

sjcos-browser-setup.service:
[Unit]
Description=SJC OS fixed browser network containment
Before=sjcos-browser-helper.service sjcos-browser-dns.service sjcos-browser-gate.service sjcos-browser.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/sjcos-browser/phase1-accepted
[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
User=root
Slice=user-@JOE_UID@-sjcosbrowser.slice
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -I -B /opt/sjcos-browser/node/source/deploy/browser/phase1-namespace.py up
ExecStop=/usr/bin/python3 -I -B /opt/sjcos-browser/node/source/deploy/browser/phase1-namespace.py down
RuntimeDirectory=sjcos-browser-setup
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700
Restart=no
TimeoutStartSec=30
TimeoutStopSec=30
MemoryMax=32M
MemorySwapMax=0
CPUQuota=10%
TasksMax=16
Nice=15
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_ADMIN CAP_SYS_ADMIN CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_NETLINK AF_INET AF_INET6
